title: Open Invoices by Customer
description: Every open invoice, debit memo and chargeback installment per customer with original, applied, credited, adjusted and remaining amounts.
sql:
SELECT hp.PARTY_NAME                              AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
       hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER                         AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
       rct.TRX_NUMBER                             AS TRX_NUMBER,
       rct.TRX_DATE                               AS TRX_DATE,
       ctt.NAME                                   AS TRX_TYPE,
       rtt.NAME                                   AS PAYMENT_TERMS,
       ps.TERMS_SEQUENCE_NUMBER                   AS INSTALLMENT,
       ps.DUE_DATE                                AS DUE_DATE,
       rct.PURCHASE_ORDER                         AS PURCHASE_ORDER,
       ps.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE                   AS CURRENCY_CODE,
       ps.AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL                     AS ORIGINAL_AMOUNT,
       ps.AMOUNT_APPLIED                          AS AMOUNT_APPLIED,
       ps.AMOUNT_CREDITED                         AS AMOUNT_CREDITED,
       ps.AMOUNT_ADJUSTED                         AS AMOUNT_ADJUSTED,
       ps.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING                    AS AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING,
       GREATEST(TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE), 0) AS DAYS_OVERDUE
FROM   AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL ps
JOIN   RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL rct   ON rct.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID = ps.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
JOIN   HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS hca      ON hca.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = ps.CUSTOMER_ID
JOIN   HZ_PARTIES hp             ON hp.PARTY_ID = hca.PARTY_ID
JOIN   RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL ctt ON ctt.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID = rct.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
LEFT JOIN RA_TERMS_TL rtt        ON rtt.TERM_ID = ps.TERM_ID
                                AND rtt.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')
WHERE  ps.STATUS = 'OP'
AND    ps.CLASS IN ('INV', 'DM', 'CB')
AND    (:P_ORG_ID IS NULL OR ps.ORG_ID = :P_ORG_ID)
AND    (:P_CUSTOMER_NUMBER IS NULL OR hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = :P_CUSTOMER_NUMBER)
AND    (:P_DUE_DATE_TO IS NULL OR TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE) <= TRUNC(:P_DUE_DATE_TO))
ORDER BY hp.PARTY_NAME, hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ps.DUE_DATE, rct.TRX_NUMBER, ps.TERMS_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
assumptions: 'Open' means a payment schedule with STATUS = 'OP'; one row per installment, so split-term invoices show several rows.
Only invoices, debit memos and chargebacks (CLASS INV, DM, CB); open credit memos and receipts are excluded.
Days overdue is measured from today (SYSDATE), never negative.
Payment terms name comes from RA_TERMS_TL in the session language.
